CA-F745C01069E53C7A8201.reason: Candidate sweep computed for research inspection; the comparison is within existing diagnostic thresholds, but those thresholds are not scientifically validated and candidates are not verified improvements to the original Stage 2A event.
CA-F745C01069E53C7A8201.method: Earth two-body point-mass RK4; mu=398600.4418 km^3/s^2; dt=5 s (convergence checked against 2.5 s); closest-approach search from burn epoch through 1800 s after original TCA, maximum 5 s sample spacing with local-minimum refinement; burn lead 300 s

ml_result.model_name: ORION simulated two-body maneuver miss-distance ranker
ml_result.score_name: predicted two-body simulated closest-approach miss distance
ml_result.score_semantics: Diagnostic estimate of the training simulator's miss-distance output only. It is not used to rank candidates because held-out selection performance did not outperform the minimum-delta-v baseline; it is not a collision probability, safety assessment, or verified improvement.

provenance.target: existing two-body simulator candidate miss distance

evaluation_summary.source: held-out synthetic scenarios; labels generated by the same two-body simulator

limitations: All training/evaluation scenarios and target labels are synthetic simulator outputs; no real maneuver outcomes were available or used.
The model approximates one specific bounded two-body simulator; it does not discover superior maneuvers and cannot validate the simulator.
No covariance, Pc, spacecraft control, execution error, attitude, propulsion, J2, drag, third-body effects, or operational constraints are modeled.
The simulator's comparison against the stored SGP4 encounter is diagnostic only; neither the model score nor physical miss distance establishes a safe or effective maneuver.

CA-F745C01069E53C7A8201.candidate_interpretation: Each candidate closest approach is a two-body simulation. Change from baseline is relative to the zero-burn two-body simulation, not automatically an improvement over the original Stage 2A SGP4 event. No Pc, operational safety, fuel savings, or recommendation is inferred.

baseline_reference_comparison.interpretation: The stored Stage 2A SGP4 event is the reference and the zero-burn two-body result is the simulated baseline. This comparison is not an independent validation. Configured thresholds are diagnostic only, not scientifically validated tolerances. Candidate changes are relative to the simulated baseline and do not establish improvement over the original event.

assumptions: Bounded interval begins at burn epoch and ends 1800 s after original event TCA; no claim is made about minima outside it
At most 721 coarse samples and 32 local-minimum refinements per candidate; golden-section refinement stops at 0.01 s or 80 iterations
TCA TEME Cartesian states treated as inertial over the configured propagation interval
burn applied to primary only at TCA minus configured lead
swept magnitudes in m/s: 0.01, 0.05
no J2, drag, third-body, covariance, execution error, attitude, or propulsion constraints
miss distance is simulated two-body geometry; no collision probability reduction or operational recommendation is inferred
baseline comparison is a diagnostic against the stored SGP4 event, not independent validation
